namespaceTemplate.rule: Every request, cache key, late-response comparison, and accepted result binds serverId + userId.

pipeline: replace each Unicode whitespace run with one ASCII space
preserve letter case for the wire searchTerm
queryNormalization.blankQuery: no request; state is IDLE_UNSUBMITTED, never EMPTY
queryNormalization.identityRule: The exact canonical searchTerm is part of queryShapeSha256; case is not silently folded.

baselinePaging.continuationRule: Keep queryShapeSha256 stable across pages except startIndex; append only pages from the same active generation and scope.

queryShape.extensionRule: Any new non-null behavioral query parameter changes queryShapeSha256 and requires a fixture update; it must not be omitted from request identity.

queryIdentity.serialization: compact JSON with ordinal key ordering; arrays preserve semantic order
queryIdentity.scopeSeparationInvariant: For the same namespace and searchTerm, ALL/VIDEO/MUSIC/BOOK produce four distinct queryShapeSha256 values.

responseValidation.http200TypePredicate: Every accepted item must match the active scope includeItemTypes and stable type label.
responseValidation.mixedValidAndInvalidItems: Keep valid items, surface PARTIAL with SCOPE_MISMATCH detail, and never relabel invalid items.
responseValidation.allItemsInvalid: PROTOCOL_ERROR with SCOPE_MISMATCH; never EMPTY and never a successful cross-scope result.

historyAnrBoundary.staticRequirement: Network, parsing, identity folding, and sorting must be cancellable work outside the UI blocking path; only a bounded state publication may run on Main.

sourceEvidence.use: route scope, state distinctions, BASE-001 acceptance, S3 query-shape gap, legacy ANR
existing SEARCH endpoint shape and scope mapping; not duplicated here
current local evidence that scope-to-type mapping exists
